title: Build Collaborative Tasks and Attachments
goal: Add realtime updates and secure file attachments while keeping the database as the durable source of truth.
steps: Open the app in two browser sessions with separate users.
Create/update/delete a task in one browser and observe events in the other.
Reconcile realtime events with TanStack Query instead of maintaining a second independent store.
Simulate duplicate and out-of-order events and decide when to refetch.
Implement file selection and validate size/type metadata before upload.
Upload to storage and write authoritative metadata to PostgreSQL.
Authorize download based on verified workspace membership.
Delete metadata/object with an explicit lifecycle that can recover from partial failure.
Attempt an unsafe upload and unauthorized download and record the security evidence.
evidence: A clean Git diff or file-tree change
Browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence that proves the behavior
One deliberate failure, the evidence you used, and the root-cause fix
A short explanation of why the final responsibility lives in the chosen layer
completion: I can reproduce one key part without the walkthrough.
I can explain one trade-off I deliberately chose.
I can show one failure that my tests, constraints, or runbook now protects against.
